title: VA treatment program with flashing images and constant MRIs while benefits were denied
place_text: VA medical system, while working for BAE

tellings.quote: that this whole thing with these flashing images, MRIs constantly, all of it. And meanwhile, they're denying all of my VA benefits.

plain: Around 2017, while he worked for the defense contractor BAE, Dylan Borland says he was put through a treatment program in the VA, the veterans' health system. It involved flashing images and constant MRI scans, while at the same time the VA denied all of his benefits. Borland tells Michels this from his own experience and points to his medical records.
